title: How stories bring me happiness - a quiet cottage vlog
en: let me tell you a story it's about a child a dreamer that wasn't too sure she ever wanted to grow up she spent her days at the trees speaking to them about her plans to be a great explorer the child built fairy houses and sketched the gnomes she spotted in the grasses she told stories to the fishers secrets to the starlings marveled at the night sky and would return home with very muddy boots one day she happened upon a portal to a wondrous land a world afflicted by eternal winter where the homely beavers and sly foxes feared to wander in the open lest vicious wolves enslave them to the service of a malevolent queen do

when the child returned to the human world she was different there was a hunger insider a desperate need for new and fantastical tales as the seasons changed and she grew older she made new acquaintances friends that would hold her hand through the tribulations of growing up some of them were real and some were in her books she had no choice but to eventually enter the land of big people and at times she felt very alone but no matter how dark things seemed her books could take her to places of hope and warmth and sweetness through her journey she found other people that were quite similar to her and that her story was shared by many and that made all the difference do you love to read i do and so it made sense that i dedicate a video to one of my greatest passions

and of course i included some recipes of some cozy drinks i might prepare for a day of reading i was recently recommended lavender hot chocolate and i simply had to try the recipe it turns out to be absolutely delicious i am not a fast reader nor do i think i have particularly good taste but it has always benefited me greatly in more ways than one reading is known to keep your memory sharp reduce stress and improve your brain connectivity plus reading about the stories of other people real or fictional challenges us to empathize and understand those from different cultures and backgrounds it also makes us question ourselves i am reticent to give recommendations since each person's taste is different however i thought i'd share some of my personal favorites i love old books on history that teach me about daily life in the past also books on nature herbs and wild crafting which i will link in the description i love thrilling dramas full of danger and secrets and i will always have a penchant for children's stories for example when i was 9 years old i fell in love with a little mouse named despero who desperately wanted to be a knight he taught me that you are who you believe

yourself to be and that comes with the responsibility of defining yourself by your strengths instead of your weaknesses as a teacher i also love children's books and have so many favorites i was recently gifted this beautifully illustrated book on mother nature do so finding a good story one that makes your heart race and your mind buzz with new thoughts and imaginings is a joy that i can compare to few things in this world the greatest gift it gives me besides transporting me into a story is that it rejuvenates my mind and brings about a wholesome sense of peace reducing my heart rate and racing thoughts and reminding me that here right now i have control my worries and fears do not need to weigh

so heavy on my shoulders and after a night of dreaming and storytelling things will inevitably be brighter in the morning i know that reading isn't everyone's preferred pastime and i would love to hear what you in particular do to relax or share some of your favorite books as you already know i am someone who has many hobbies and i find that the process of slowing down and concentrating on a task reading or otherwise gives me a sense of strength that in a world full of distractions and stimulation i can choose to take a deep breath and reset
zh: 让我告诉你一个故事，这是关于一个孩子的故事，一个梦想家，她不太确定自己是否想长大，她在树上度过了很多日子，告诉他们她想成为一名伟大的探险家，孩子建造了童话屋，画出了她在草丛中发现的侏儒，她给渔夫讲故事，给椋鸟讲故事，惊叹于夜空，她会穿着沾满泥的靴子回家，有一天，她偶然发现了一扇通往奇妙土地的大门，一个被永恒冬天折磨的世界。朴素的海狸和狡猾的狐狸不敢在空旷的地方徘徊，以免恶毒的狼奴役它们，为恶毒的女王服务。

当孩子回到人类世界时，她变得不同了，她内心深处渴望新奇的故事，随着季节的变化，她长大了，她结识了新朋友，他们会牵着她的手度过成长的磨难，有些是真实的，有些是她的书里的，她别无选择，只能最终进入大人物的土地，有时她感到非常孤独，但无论事情看起来多么黑暗，她的书可以在她的旅程中带她到希望、温暖和甜蜜的地方。其他与她非常相似的人，她的故事被许多人分享，这让一切变得不同你喜欢阅读我喜欢，所以我将一个视频献给我最大的热情之一是有道理的

当然，我还包括了一些舒适饮料的食谱，我可能会为一天的阅读做准备，最近有人推荐薰衣草热巧克力，我只需尝试一下这个食谱，结果证明它绝对美味，我的阅读速度不是很快，我也不认为自己有特别好的品味，但它总是以比一次阅读更多的方式使我受益匪浅，它可以让你的记忆力敏锐，减轻压力，提高你的大脑连通性，再加上阅读其他人的故事，真实或虚构的故事挑战我们同情和理解来自不同文化和背景的人，这也使我们问问自己 我不愿意给出建议，因为每个人的品味不同，但我想我会分享一些我个人最喜欢的东西 我喜欢关于历史的老书，它们教我过去的日常生活，还有关于自然草药和野生手工艺的书籍，我将在描述中链接它们 我喜欢充满危险和秘密的惊心动魄的戏剧，我永远对儿童故事有兴趣，例如，当我 9 岁时，我爱上了一只名叫德斯佩罗的小老鼠，他非常想成为他教的骑士我知道你就是你所相信的人

作为一名老师，我有责任通过自己的优点而不是缺点来定义自己，我也喜欢儿童读物，并且有很多最爱，最近我收到了这本关于大自然的精美插图的书，所以找到一个好故事，一个让你心跳加速，让你的大脑充满新想法和想象的好故事，这是一种快乐，我可以与这个世界上很少有的东西相比，它给我的最大礼物除了把我带入一个故事之外，它还让我的思想焕发活力，带来一种健康的和平感。我的心率和急速的思绪提醒我，现在我已经控制了我的担忧和恐惧，不需要权衡
我的肩膀如此沉重，经过一夜的梦想和讲故事之后，早上的事情不可避免地会变得更加光明，我知道阅读并不是每个人都喜欢的消遣，我很想听听你具体做了什么来放松或分享一些你最喜欢的书，因为你已经知道我是一个有很多爱好的人，我发现放慢速度并专注于任务阅读或其他方式的过程给了我一种力量感，在一个充满干扰和刺激的世界中，我可以选择深呼吸和重置
